note: Recorded impact analysis of Corrigendum 2 (grievance timeline 7 to 5 working days).

affected.reason: States the 7 working day grievance resolution timeline of GO para 7.3, now 5 working days under COR2-1.
affected.proposedChange: Change the resolution timeline to 5 working days and escalate on the 6th working day.
affected.newDescription: The system shall track every grievance against a resolution timeline of 5 working days from receipt, show the working days remaining to the District Social Welfare Officer, and escalate a grievance not resolved within 5 working days to the Joint Director, Social Welfare.
newAcceptanceCriteria: Given a grievance received on a Monday, when the DSWO opens the grievance list, then the grievance shows the working days remaining out of 5.

Given a grievance not resolved within 5 working days, when the daily job runs on the 6th working day, then it is escalated to the Joint Director, Social Welfare and both officers are notified by email.

affected.proposedChange: Expected remaining days shown out of 5 instead of 7.
Escalation expected on the 6th working day instead of the 8th.

affected.reason: Grievance disposal by the DSWO must now be completed within 5 working days; the requirement does not state the timeline the officer is held to.
affected.proposedChange: Add the 5 working day disposal timeline to the acceptance criteria.
affected.newDescription: The system shall allow the District Social Welfare Officer to record the action taken and close a grievance within 5 working days of receipt, and send an SMS to the applicant with the action taken.
newAcceptanceCriteria: Given an action taken report of at least 50 characters, when the DSWO closes the grievance, then the applicant receives an SMS with the action taken.
Given a grievance received 5 working days ago, when the DSWO opens the grievance list, then it is marked as due today.

response.timelineImpact: Low. Text changes to two requirements and their test cases, and the grievance escalation parameter changes from 7 to 5 working days. No change to the data model, integrations or the application workflow. Indicative effort 2 to 3 person-days including regression testing of grievance escalation.
